For **spiritual practice**, the best fit in your results is usually **Insight Timer’s shadow-work courses**, especially *Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth* and *Shadow Work Toolkit For Deep Inner Healing*, because they combine inner-healing methods with meditation-oriented delivery and spiritual integration language.[17][19]

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | Jungian shadow work | An in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work, part of a broader Jungian psychology series.[6][14] |

If you want the **best overall quality**, I’d start with **Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow*** for a more psychologically grounded approach, then choose **Awake Academy** or **ManTalks** if you want a more guided, practice-heavy experience.[6][16][20]

If you want the **best spiritual-practice blend**, I’d look first at **Insight Timer** and then **Udemy** for lower-cost, self-paced options with meditation and spiritual language.[17][19][2][10]

A practical way to choose:
- Pick **Jung Platform** if you want a more *Jungian* and theory-informed course.[6][14]
- Pick **Awake Academy** if you want a *deep, facilitator-led* transformation course.[20]
- Pick **ManTalks** if you want a *multi-week guided journey*.[16]
- Pick **Insight Timer** if you want shadow work embedded in a *meditation/spiritual practice* environment.[17][19]
- Pick **Udemy** if you want a *low-cost, beginner-friendly* option.[2][10][11]
